model: Qwen3-VL-4B B.5'' v2 VLA (1-cam + HD-map + bbox + ego)
backend: FULL PIPELINE: vision(HF bf16, GPU, timed) -> fastervlmx4(timed) -> LM(TRT-LLM 1.3.0rc15, bf16, embedding-injection)
native_vision_in_trt_reason: Two SEPARATE facts. (1) The native in-engine multimodal path is blocked for THIS model because TRT-LLM 1.3.0rc15 Qwen3VisionModelBase.forward (modeling_qwen3vl.py:920) raises ValueError('Currently only support single modality per request') and B.5'' sends video+image in one request. (2) The ViT being bf16 in the in-engine path is NOT a TRT capability limit and NOT 'unquantizable by design' — the bundled Qwen3-VL class STRIPS the ViT quant config on load (modeling_qwen3vl.py:823), a framework integration choice. The ViT IS quantizable; the deployable route is the automotive vision-as-separate-engine pattern: modelopt-quantize model.visual, run it as its own quantized module/engine, feed pruned embeddings to the LM engine. That is what this bench's vision stage does for fp8/nvfp4. See FULL_PIPELINE_FEASIBILITY.md.

vision.reason_not_quantized: precision=bf16 -> vision correctly stays bf16. (For fp8/nvfp4 the ViT IS quantized via modelopt; see quant_vision.py.)

decode_total.note: total decode time for 13 tokens (= LM full generate - prefill TTFT)

gpu_mem_gb.note: peak across vision tower (bf16) + TRT LM engine resident together. NOTE: fake-quant vision holds extra scale/observer tensors, so peak is not a quantized-ViT memory saving; a real fp8 ViT engine would reduce ViT resident mem.

l2_note: Planning L2 (TemAvg, metres) of the FULL quantized pipeline (bf16 vision + fastervlmx4 compress + bf16 LM) decoded trajectories vs nuScenes ground-truth waypoints. The HF bf16 baseline for the SAME N samples (run scripts/planning_eval.py on final/) is the apples-to-apples accuracy reference; a near-equal L2 here means quantization+compression did not degrade trajectory quality.
